leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a micro-frontend architecture using module federation
Configure independent deployment pipelines for separate micro-frontend applications
Implement communication patterns between micro-frontends using custom events or shared state
Integrate multiple framework-based micro-frontends into a single host application
Manipulate shared dependencies to prevent version conflicts across micro-frontends
Initialize and render micro-frontends dynamically based on user navigation
Apply lazy loading techniques to optimize micro-frontend performance
